description: Web app for Indonesian mothers/families to manage school schedules, homework, meal planning, finances, notes, shopping, and family events in one dashboard.
creator: Ema Istianasari

features.sign_up: User enters email + password (min 6 chars), auto-logged in after signup
features.demo_account: demo@email.com / demo123 (pre-filled button on landing page)

authentication.auth_context: AuthContext.tsx provides user, loading, signUp, signIn, signOut
authentication.onboarding_flow: After first login → welcome screen → enter mama name → enter children (name, grade, color) → complete

navigation.settings_access: Via gear icon on Dashboard header

landing_page.description: Marketing landing page with hero, features grid, benefits, how-to steps, target audience, CTA, contact, footer
sections: Hero with gradient text and CTA buttons (Daftar Gratis / Coba Demo)
Features grid (6 feature cards with icons)
Who is it for (3 audience types)

dashboard.description: Main hub showing overview of all features
sections: Greeting header with mama name, date, settings button
Quick stats grid (6 cards): Notes, Events, Meals, Homework, Finance, Shopping - each navigates to its tab
School schedule by day selector (Senin-Sabtu) with child avatars, subjects, uniform, hours
Finance summary card with budget vs actual progress bar
Daily tips (rotating, 10 tips, day-of-year based selection)
data_loaded: Today's school schedule (per child, per selected day)
dashboard.refresh_behavior: Reloads on visibility change, window focus, and scheduleUpdated custom event

features: Monthly grid calendar with event dots (colored by child)
Add event modal (title, category, child, date, time, notes)
Quick Input (copy-paste from WhatsApp) - parses category, child name, date (DD/MM/YYYY), time (HH:MM)
Click date to see all events for that day in bottom sheet
Add homework modal (child, subject, description, deadline)
Quick Input (copy-paste from WA) - parses child name, subject, description, deadline

meal_planner.description: Weekly meal planning with recipe library, fridge inventory, and shopping list
planner_features: Weekly grid (Senin-Minggu) with 4 meal types per day: sarapan, bekal, siang, malam
Click slot to select recipe from library
Generate shopping list from planned meals
fridge_features: Categories: Protein, Sayur, Karbohidrat, Bumbu, Lainnya
AI-like recipe matcher: finds recipes matching fridge ingredients (perfect ≥70% match, partial ≥30%)
Add missing ingredients to shopping list
shopping_features: Transfer items to main shopping list (Shopping tab)

features: Summary header: total budget, total expenses, paid, unpaid, cashback
Budget vs actual per category with progress bars
Financial analysis (AI-like tips based on top expense category)
Expense list with paid/unpaid status, cashback display
Add expense modal (category, amount, date, payment method, cashback, notes, paid, recurring)

notes.description: Sticky notes with pin and done states
features: Pin/unpin notes (pinned shown in yellow section)

shopping.description: Shopping list with quantity, price, category
features: Quick Input (copy-paste list) - auto-detects quantity (kg/gr/buah), price (Rp), category
Estimate total price for pending items

settings.description: Profile, children, schedule, notes, and shopping management
children_tab: Add child (name, grade, color picker from 6 colors)
schedule_tab: Quick Input (copy-paste from WA) - parses day, subjects, hours, uniform
Save schedule (upsert with unique constraint on child_id + day_of_week)
notes_tab: Quick Input (batch notes, one per line)

quick_input.description: Reusable component for copy-paste data entry from WhatsApp/Notes

parsing_capabilities.calendar: Detects category keywords, child names, dates (DD/MM/YYYY), times (HH:MM)
parsing_capabilities.homework: Detects child names, subject (after 'PR '/'Tugas '), deadlines (DD/MM/YYYY or 'Deadline:' prefix)
parsing_capabilities.shopping: Detects quantity (kg/gr/buah/pcs etc), price (Rp), auto-categorizes by keyword
parsing_capabilities.schedule: Detects day names, subjects, hours (contains 'jam' or time pattern), uniform (contains 'seragam'/'baju')

database_schema.rls: Enabled on ALL tables - users can only access their own data

columns.user_id: uuid FK → user_profiles(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
columns.name: text NOT NULL

tables.name: schedules
tables.purpose: School schedule per child per day

columns.child_id: uuid FK → children(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

rls_policies: CRUD via EXISTS check on children.user_id = auth.uid()

tables.name: homework

columns.child_id: uuid FK → children(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
columns.subject: text NOT NULL

rls_policies: CRUD via EXISTS check on children.user_id = auth.uid()

tables.name: user_recipes
tables.purpose: Custom user recipes (older table, may be unused)

tables.name: meal_plans
tables.purpose: Daily meal planning (older table, may be unused)

tables.name: shopping_list
tables.purpose: Main shopping list (used by Shopping.tsx and Settings.tsx)

tables.name: announcements
tables.purpose: Parsed school announcements (table exists but no UI component uses it)

tables.name: events
tables.purpose: Family and school events on calendar

columns.child_id: uuid FK → children(id) ON DELETE CASCADE (nullable)
columns.title: text NOT NULL

tables.name: recipes
tables.purpose: Recipe library (default + user-created, used by MealPlanner)

columns.name: text NOT NULL
columns.ingredients: jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]' (array of {name, amount})

rls_policies: SELECT: is_default = true OR auth.uid() = user_id
INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE: auth.uid() = user_id AND is_default = false

tables.name: weekly_meal_plans
tables.purpose: Weekly meal planning (used by MealPlanner, newer version of meal_plans)

columns.recipe_id: uuid FK → recipes(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

tables.name: shopping_lists
tables.purpose: Meal-plan-generated shopping list (used by MealPlanner, separate from shopping_list)

contexts.AuthContext.tsx: Manages Supabase auth state (user, loading, signIn, signUp, signOut)
contexts.AppContext.tsx: Manages app data (profile, children, selectedChild, refresh functions)

component_architecture.routing: No router library - conditional rendering based on auth state + activeTab useState

flow.user_onboarded: Main app with bottom nav tabs

components: App.tsx - Root component with tab routing
MealPlanner.tsx - Weekly meal planner + fridge + recipes
Auth.tsx - Standalone auth component (appears unused, superseded by LandingPage)
component_architecture.lib: supabase.ts - Client init + TypeScript type definitions for all tables

ai_like_features.note: No actual AI/ML integration exists. 'AI-like' features use rule-based logic.

features.name: Daily Tips
features.description: 10 hardcoded parenting/productivity tips, rotated by day-of-year

features.name: Financial Analysis
features.description: Rule-based tips: over-budget warning, essential vs non-essential category analysis, top expense category percentage

features.name: Recipe Matcher
features.description: Ingredient matching algorithm: normalizes ingredient names, checks fridge inventory against recipe ingredients, classifies as perfect (≥70% match) or partial (≥30%)

features.name: Quick Input Parser
features.description: Regex-based parser for copy-pasted text from WhatsApp: detects dates, times, quantities, prices, categories, child names

duplicate_tables: meal_plans (older) vs weekly_meal_plans (newer) - both exist, MealPlanner uses weekly_meal_plans
shopping_list (main) vs shopping_lists (meal plan generated) - separate tables, items transferred between them
user_recipes (older) vs recipes (newer with is_default) - MealPlanner uses recipes
unused_components: Auth.tsx - standalone auth component, superseded by LandingPage.tsx
unused_tables: announcements - table exists with RLS but no UI component references it
known_issues_and_gaps.no_real_ai: README mentions AI-powered features but implementation is rule-based, no external AI API integration
known_issues_and_gaps.no_realtime: No Supabase realtime subscriptions - data refreshes via visibility change, focus events, and manual reloads
known_issues_and_gaps.no_notifications: No push notifications or in-app notification system despite README mentioning reminders
known_issues_and_gaps.no_offline_support: No PWA caching or offline data strategy beyond Supabase client defaults
known_issues_and_gaps.no_error_handling_on_ui: Most supabase calls use destructured { data } without checking error, errors are silently ignored
known_issues_and_gaps.no_loading_states_per_page: Only Dashboard has a loading spinner; other pages load data without individual loading indicators
known_issues_and_gaps.no_form_validation: Minimal validation - mostly just required field checks, no email format validation, no password strength
known_issues_and_gaps.demo_account: Hardcoded demo credentials in LandingPage.tsx (demo@email.com / demo123)
